summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gets `import enum` and a new EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) with the eleven members at the end of the module; botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean; tests/unit/test_args.py gets TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 23 tests. tests/unit/test_args.py passes (60 tests). The full unit suite has 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py and test_session*.py::test_internal_component, which also fail on untouched HEAD. black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand only. Nothing is committed.
